offers.title: WordPress with MariaDB
offers.description: Invite people to browse this image’s running website. Files, posts, forms and other changes stay on the hosting computer.

offers.title: WordPress MySQL connection
offers.description: Connect to the WordPress database with an interactive MariaDB SQL client.
offers.warning: Invited people can edit the host’s WordPress database. This demo has no database password.

joins.title: Open WordPress with MariaDB
joins.description: Join this network and connect to the existing host service. This computer does not start a duplicate server.

joins.title: Open WordPress MySQL connection
joins.description: Run SQL against the host’s WordPress database. Try SHOW TABLES; or SELECT option_name, option_value FROM wp_options WHERE option_name = 'blogname';
